questions.question_english: A well-functioning grievance redressal mechanism for safety issues in a school must possess which of the following essential characteristics?
options_english: It must charge a nominal fee to discourage false complaints.
It must ensure that the identity and name of the complainant are publicly announced during the school morning assembly.
It must guarantee confidentiality, nonretaliation, and an option for anonymous reporting.
It must process complaints only at the end of the academic year.
questions.explanation_english: Grievance redressal mechanisms must protect complainant confidentiality, guarantee protection against retaliation, and provide anonymous reporting options. Creating safe reporting channels removes psychological barriers, encouraging victims and witnesses to disclose harassment, bullying, or safety violations freely. Confidential handling ensures impartial administrative investigations while fully protecting reporting individuals from victimisation, social stigma, or harassment.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। शिकायत निवारण तंत्र को शिकायतकर्ता की गोपनीयता की रक्षा करनी चाहिए, प्रतिशोध से सुरक्षा की गारंटी देनी चाहिए, और गुमनाम रिपोर्टिंग के विकल्प प्रदान करने चाहिए। सुरक्षित रिपोर्टिंग चैनल बनाने से मनोवैज्ञानिक बाधाएँ समाप्त होती हैं, जिससे पीड़ितों और गवाहों को उत्पीड़न, धमकाने या सुरक्षा उल्लंघनों को स्वतंत्र रूप से उजागर करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है। गोपनीयता से निपटने से निष्पक्ष प्रशासनिक जांच सुनिश्चित होती है जबकि रिपोर्टिंग व्यक्तियों को शिकार, सामाजिक कलंक या उत्पीड़न से पूरी तरह से सुरक्षित रखा जाता है।
questions.topic: MoE NCPCR and NDMA Guidelines for School Safety and Security
key_facts: GFR Clause: Confidentiality in grievance handling.
CCS Conduct Rules: Protection against retaliation.
Printed answer key: (C) It must guarantee confidentiality, nonretaliation, and an option for anonymous reporting.

questions.question_english: How frequently should the structural safety certificate of a school building be renewed by the competent authority?
options_english: Once every 5 years
Annually, or as prescribed by the local civic authority norms
Mandatory evaluation conducted only once at the initial time of school establishment and recognition
Bi-annually
questions.explanation_english: Structural safety certificates must be periodically evaluated and renewed, typically on an annual basis or as mandated by local municipal authorities. Regular technical assessments verify the ongoing structural integrity of school buildings, identifying load-bearing defects, material degradation, or environmental wear. Timely inspections ensure compliance with building standards, protecting occupants from structural failure or hazardous building conditions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। संरचनात्मक सुरक्षा प्रमाणपत्रों का समय-समय पर मूल्यांकन और नवीनीकरण किया जाना चाहिए, आमतौर पर वार्षिक आधार पर या स्थानीय नगरपालिका प्राधिकरण द्वारा निर्धारित मानदंडों के अनुसार। नियमित तकनीकी मूल्यांकन स्कूल भवनों की संरचनात्मक अखंडता की निरंतरता की पुष्टि करते हैं, लोड-बेयरिंग दोष, सामग्री का क्षय, या पर्यावरणीय पहनने की पहचान करते हैं। समय पर निरीक्षण भवन मानकों के अनुपालन को सुनिश्चित करते हैं, जिससे निवासियों को संरचनात्मक विफलता या खतरनाक भवन स्थितियों से सुरक्षा मिलती है।
questions.topic: MoE NCPCR and NDMA Guidelines for School Safety and Security
key_facts: Structural safety certificates are required to be renewed annually or as per local authority norms.
Regular inspections help in identifying potential structural issues.
Printed answer key: (B) Annually, or as prescribed by the local civic authority norms.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is a non-structural mitigation measure to prevent injuries during an earthquake in a school?
options_english: Fastening heavy cabinets, almirahs, and display boards securely to the walls
Retrofitting load-bearing walls
Digging and laying significantly deeper concrete foundations during the initial construction of the main building
Upgrading the cement quality of the roof
questions.explanation_english: Non-structural seismic mitigation involves securing internal contents, appliances, and furnishings to prevent tipping or detachment during ground shaking. Anchoring heavy almirahs, library shelves, wall hangings, and laboratory equipment to structural walls eliminates falling object hazards. Implementing low-cost non-structural securing measures effectively prevents severe crushing injuries and maintains clear internal escape routes throughout facilities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। गैर-संरचनात्मक भूकंपीय कमजोरियों को रोकने के लिए आंतरिक सामग्री, उपकरण और फर्नीचर को सुरक्षित करना आवश्यक है ताकि जमीन हिलने के दौरान वे गिर न जाएं। भारी अल्मीराह, पुस्तकालय की अलमारियों, दीवारों पर लटकने वाली वस्तुओं और प्रयोगशाला के उपकरणों को संरचनात्मक दीवारों से बांधने से गिरने वाले वस्तुओं के खतरों को समाप्त किया जा सकता है। कम लागत वाले गैर-संरचनात्मक सुरक्षा उपायों को लागू करने से गंभीर कुचलने वाली चोटों को रोकने में मदद मिलती है और सुविधाओं के भीतर स्पष्ट आंतरिक निकासी मार्ग बनाए रखे जाते हैं।
questions.topic: MoE NCPCR and NDMA Guidelines for School Safety and Security
key_facts: Non-structural measures are crucial for safety during earthquakes.
Securing heavy furniture prevents injuries from falling objects.
Printed answer key: (A) Fastening heavy cabinets, almirahs, and display boards securely to the walls.

questions.question_english: Who holds the ultimate administrative responsibility for ensuring that safety policies are implemented effectively within school premises?
options_english: The respective Class Teachers
The President of the Parent-Teacher Association
The Head of the Institution / Principal
The local Station House Officer (SHO) of Police
questions.explanation_english: The Head of the Institution or Principal carries ultimate administrative responsibility for overall operational management and policy implementation within school premises. As institutional leaders, principals direct safety protocols, enforce compliance, monitor campus security, and coordinate emergency responses. Executive leadership ensures that designated safety guidelines are systematically executed, staff responsibilities are defined, and institutional accountability for student welfare is continuously maintained.

questions.question_english: Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Assertion (A): Fire safety drills should occasionally be conducted unannounced. Reason (R): Unannounced drills help evaluate the true preparedness and reflexive response of the school population during an unexpected emergency.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Conducting unannounced fire safety drills provides accurate evaluations of institutional preparedness, response efficiency, and practical system readiness under realistic conditions. Scheduled drills often lead to preplanned responses that fail to reflect actual emergency behaviors. Surprise scenario drills expose operational bottlenecks, test real-time reactions, and ensure that the school population is genuinely prepared for emergencies.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। बिना सूचना के अग्नि सुरक्षा अभ्यास आयोजित करने से संस्थागत तैयारी, प्रतिक्रिया दक्षता और वास्तविक परिस्थितियों में प्रणाली की तत्परता का सटीक मूल्यांकन होता है। निर्धारित अभ्यास अक्सर पूर्व-निर्धारित प्रतिक्रियाओं की ओर ले जाते हैं जो वास्तविक आपातकालीन व्यवहार को नहीं दर्शाते। आश्चर्यजनक परिदृश्य अभ्यास संचालन में बाधाओं को उजागर करते हैं, वास्तविक समय की प्रतिक्रियाओं का परीक्षण करते हैं, और सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि स्कूल की जनसंख्या आपातकाल के लिए वास्तव में तैयार है।

questions.question_english: What is the primary function of the School Safety Committee?
options_english: To develop, monitor, and evaluate the implementation of the School Safety Policy and Disaster Management Plan
To independently audit, verify, and approve all annual financial expenditures, income taxes, and balance sheets of the school trust
To recruit permanent teaching staff
To decide the academic curriculum and textbooks
questions.explanation_english: The School Safety Committee formulates, monitors, and evaluates safety policies, disaster management strategies, and physical security measures across campus. The committee conducts hazard assessments, coordinates safety drills, reviews grievance records, and ensures compliance with statutory child protection regulations. Active operational oversight builds a proactive security environment responsive to evolving institutional safety priorities.

questions.question_english: In school safety management, the concept of the 'Whole School Approach' refers to which of the following?

Restricting safety management to the physical infrastructure of the school building
Delegating all safety compliance tasks to an external private security agency

questions.explanation_english: The Whole School Approach to safety emphasizes active participation and collaboration among all institutional stakeholders. Shared responsibility ensures consistent awareness, timely risk identification, and comprehensive implementation of protective measures across the entire educational environment.

questions.question_english: In the context of anti-bullying guidelines, which of the following best defines 'bullying'?

Intentional, repeated aggressive behavior involving an imbalance of power, causing physical or psychological harm

questions.explanation_english: Bullying is defined as intentional, repeated aggressive behavior involving a real or perceived power imbalance that causes physical, verbal, or psychological harm. questions.question_english: What is the correct protocol for evacuation during an earthquake drill?

Remain completely inside the classroom building for at least two full hours after the initial earthquake shaking stops
Wait until the shaking stops entirely, then evacuate in an orderly manner to the open assembly area.

questions.explanation_english: Immediate structural evacuation during active seismic shaking is dangerous due to falling debris, destabilized stairways, and loss of footing. Systematic post-shake evacuation along pre-mapped safe routes prevents trip injuries and panic while moving populations to open assembly grounds.

questions.question_english: Which type of fire extinguisher is most appropriate for a school computer laboratory where fires may involve live electrical equipment?

Carbon Dioxide (CO2) or Clean Agent extinguisher

questions.explanation_english: Carbon Dioxide and Clean Agent extinguishers are specifically designed to extinguish Class C electrical fires without conducting electricity or damaging sensitive electronic components. Deploying non-conductive suppression agents in computer laboratories ensures rapid fire suppression while safeguarding human operators and technical equipment assets.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड और क्लीन एजेंट अग्निशामक विशेष रूप से कक्षा C की विद्युत आगों को बुझाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए हैं, बिना विद्युत प्रवाह को संचालित किए या संवेदनशील इलेक्ट्रॉनिक घटकों को नुकसान पहुँचाए। जल या फोम आधारित अग्निशामक सामग्री गंभीर विद्युत प्रवाह के जोखिम प्रस्तुत करती है और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक प्रणालियों को नष्ट कर देती है। कंप्यूटर प्रयोगशालाओं में गैर-चालक दमन एजेंटों का उपयोग तेजी से आग बुझाने को सुनिश्चित करता है, जबकि मानव ऑपरेटरों और तकनीकी उपकरणों के संपत्तियों की सुरक्षा करता है।
